title: The unit of "changed together"

options.by: assumption: not recorded for every repository

options.t: the commit as the base fact; the pull request's file set as a second label where the host records it

counts: how often a pull request spans several commits, and how far the two file sets differ
refuted: the two label sets nearly always agree (then one suffices)

title: Three tables of examples

options.t: one table per question: entity, what is known when asked, label, time

counts: task texts and error texts tied to a resolving change, per repository
assume: the error label is the non-test files of the fixing change
refuted: too few error examples even to test on

title: Weights of examples

options.by: D 2.2; D 2.8 (a file is drawn once per change it is in)

options.t: one starting file per change per pass
one unit of weight per change; equal weight per repository

refuted: small changes get worse and large ones do not gain

title: Tests and measures

options.t: one pooled time split, precision in the top ten
three tests (future of seen, never seen, the two private); ranking measures; a change is never split; right files of one change never count against each other

refuted: the three tests always agree (then one suffices)

title: Profiling and leak test

options.t: trust the extraction, review its code
stated keys tested at every load; a description of each repository; an automatic leak test

counts: what the first draw shows is an estimate from a sample; every key is tested again on the full draw
refuted: a stated key fails for a reason that is not an extraction fault

title: The store read as a graph

options.t: the change is a node; kinds of link with direction and time; no identities

refuted: a model reading it does no better than one reading the file-to-file graph
